title: white/silver silent run 12" clock
text: white/silver silent run 12" clock. This is a lovely and very nicely quiet clock - sweep hand - no ticking.  It takes a AA battery (NOT included).  I love the white/silver color palate - very subtle.  12" round.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Tosnail 12 Inches Round Silent Non Ticking Quartz Wall Clock - Elegant Silver Frame
features: Size: 12" in dia. x 1.5" thick. Easy to hang. Easy to clean.
Powered by 1 AA battery; Battery Not Included.
Non ticking - Quiet sweep second hand, no ticking to ensure a good sleeping or working environment.
Easy to Read - Large silver numbers in white background and clear glass lens allows easy reading.
Modern and simple design to fit into any decoration; Great for office, classroom, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and any room in your home.
